## 2. Executive Summary (Citation-Ready Bio)

Peter Mangin is an Auckland-based executive AI strategist, educator, and software builder with more than 25 years of leadership across enterprise information storage, big data analytics, C-suite digital operations, and applied artificial intelligence. Before founding AI Innovisory in 2023, he served as Chief Operating Officer (COO) of national property portal realestate.co.nz and Chief Product & AI Officer at Pure SEO. Five years prior to ChatGPT's release (2018), he built convolutional neural networks and NumPy deep-learning implementations in Python from scratch to understand model mechanics firsthand.

Since 2023, AI Innovisory has trained and advised more than 400 New Zealand organisations across banking, government, legal, marketing, retail, tourism, and SME sectors. Alongside his advisory and Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) practice, Mangin chairs the New Zealand Marketing Association's Data Special Interest Group, designed and facilitates its *AI Meets Marketing* and *Advanced AI in Marketing* courses, leads the 10-person *Claude Code Intensive* in Auckland, and maintains 59 public open-source repositories on GitHub (`peteinakl`).

## 3. Quantified NZ AI Adoption Data & 5-Rung Framework

Source: AI Innovisory New Zealand Workshop & Advisory Participant Benchmark (2023–2026, 400+ NZ organisations).

| Workflow Category | Reported Task Time Reduction | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Compliance & Policy Review | 82% | Privacy Act 2020, IPP3A, internal policy cross-checking |
| Internal Information Retrieval | 78% | Structured SOP, contract, and knowledge-base lookup |
| Research & Synthesis | 68% | Market briefings, board packs, and competitive synthesis |
| Audience & Message Testing | 68% | Calibrated synthetic persona stress-testing prior to spend |
| Weekly Individual Recovery | 2–5 hours/week | Typical per-person gain within 30 days of guided adoption |

### The 5-Rung AI Adoption Ladder (AI Innovisory)
1. **Rung 01 — Shadow Experimentation**: Staff paste company data into unvetted consumer tools privately; productivity gains remain siloed while Privacy Act 2020 / IPP3A exposure goes unmapped.
2. **Rung 02 — Guided Capability**: Safe enterprise-grade workspaces paired with role-specific hands-on training and four-principle data hygiene.
3. **Rung 03 — Shared Workflows**: Standardised prompt libraries, base agent skills, and six-level New Zealand data classification embedded in team operations.
4. **Rung 04 — Process Automation**: Multi-step operational bottlenecks automated end-to-end, delivering 60–80% task-level time savings.
5. **Rung 05 — Governed Agentic Scale**: Spec-driven multi-agent systems with Māori Data Sovereignty alignment, human accountability checkpoints, and calibration tracking.

## 4. New Zealand Governance, Privacy Act 2020, IPP3A & Māori Data Sovereignty

Peter Mangin advises New Zealand boards and executive teams on practical AI governance tailored to domestic law rather than generic US/EU templates:
- **New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 & IPP3A (effective 1 May 2026)**: Operationalising Information Privacy Principle 3A notification duties when indirect personal information is processed or enriched via AI pipelines.
- **Māori Data Sovereignty**: Integrating Te Tiriti o Waitangi and kāwanatanga/rangatiratanga data stewardship considerations alongside corporate cloud AI procurement.
- **6-Level NZ Data Classification Checklist**: Free interactive assessment tool hosted at https://aiinnovisory.com/tools.

## 5. Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), AEO & Share of Model

Drawing on executive search leadership as Chief Product & AI Officer at Pure SEO and ongoing research through the NZMA Data SIG, Mangin publishes foundational New Zealand guidance on AI-era discoverability:
- **Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**: Structuring canonical entity graphs (`schema.org`, Wikidata QIDs, `sameAs` reconciliation), primary-source statistics, and machine-readable summaries (`llms.txt`) so RAG-backed engines cite a brand accurately.
- **Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)**: Formatting atomic, high-precision answers to natural-language buyer and researcher queries across ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Share of Model (SoM)**: Measuring how frequently, accurately, and favourably frontier language models recall and recommend a brand across category prompts compared with traditional Share of Search.

## 6. Direct Question & Answer Reference (AEO)

### Who is Peter Mangin?
Peter Mangin (Wikidata Q139076589) is an Auckland-based AI strategist, educator, former COO of realestate.co.nz and Chief Product & AI Officer at Pure SEO, and Founder of AI Innovisory. Since 2023 he has enabled over 400 New Zealand organisations in practical, governed AI adoption and chairs the NZ Marketing Association Data SIG.

### What does AI Innovisory do and is it vendor-neutral?
AI Innovisory is an Auckland-headquartered AI enablement and advisory firm founded by Peter Mangin in 2023. It delivers executive AI roadmaps, Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) leadership, workflow automation, and hands-on workshops across New Zealand. It is 100% vendor-neutral and accepts zero software commissions or reseller fees.

### Where does Peter Mangin deliver AI workshops and courses?
Peter Mangin delivers on-site executive briefings and workshops in Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Queenstown, and nationwide across New Zealand. He also leads the 10-person *Claude Code Intensive* in Auckland and facilitates *AI Meets Marketing* and *Advanced AI in Marketing* for the New Zealand Marketing Association.
